WPSS No.1034 of 2020
Hon’ble Lok Pal Singh, J.
Mr. Bharat Singh, Advocate for the 
petitioner.
Mr. Azim Sheikh, Standing Counsel for 
Union of India/respondent nos.1 and 2.
Mrs. Monika Pant, Advocate for 
respondent nos.3 and 4.
The copy of the writ petition has not 
been served to respondent no.3 and 4.
Learned counsel for the petitioner is 
directed to serve the copy of the writ petition to 
the respondent nos.3 and 4 within two days.
Learned counsel for respondents seeks 
and is granted six weeks’ time to file counter 
affidavit.
List immediately thereafter.
 (Lok Pal Singh, J.)
 15.09.2020
